`python-1.1.0.tar.gz` was generated by the original Python `warden.backup.backup`
implementation at commit `5a60ca5`, using an isolated temporary home directory.
It contains synthetic non-key text, a fixture identity, one SSH host, an npm
package, and a developer-tool entry. It intentionally reproduces Python's two
copies of the same Git/SSH key pair. No real credentials are included.

The Go test restores it twice, checks module contents and rewritten references,
and asserts that only one key pair is stored. Python is not needed to run it.
